summarization:
The smartphone UI screen displays a loading screen with a circular loading icon and the text "Loading..." in the center. Below the loading message, there are three main buttons:

1. "Create New Account" - likely for new users to sign up.
2. "Log in with Virtuagym" - for existing users to log in using their Virtuagym credentials.
3. "Log in with Facebook" - for users to log in using their Facebook account.

The background appears to be an image of a natural landscape, but it is dimmed due to the loading overlay. The status bar at the top shows various icons, including battery status, signal strength, and the current time (2:48).
